last.verdict: Opendoor has loaded up on homes it is struggling to resell at a profit, and it expects bigger losses next quarter.

takeaways.label: Margin missed guidance
takeaways.text: Profit margin on homes sold was 3.3%, below the 4%–4.5% guided last quarter and down from 5.8%. Profit per home fell to about $12,000 from $22,000.

takeaways.label: Losses to widen
takeaways.text: Next-quarter adjusted EBITDA loss is guided at $70M–$85M, versus $31M this quarter. Profit dollars per home sold are expected to fall again in what management calls a difficult market.

takeaways.label: Inventory pile-up
takeaways.text: Homes held rose to 7,596 and inventory to $2.57B, from $1.05B a year ago. Opendoor bought 4,865 homes, but only 2,728 sold.

takeaways.label: Debt due within a year
takeaways.text: Debt due within a year, mostly home-backed loans, jumped to $2.0B from $52M at year-end. Cash was $910M, and nine-month operating cash outflow was $1.8B.

history.verdict: Investors sold on a weak margin outlook despite revenue and cash-burn improvement.

reasons.label: Lower margin outlook
reasons.text: Next-quarter contribution margin guided to 4%–4.5%, below this quarter's 5.8%, blamed on seasonality.

reasons.label: Sales far below last year
reasons.text: Revenue was $883M, down about 44% from a year ago, and below analyst estimates.

reasons.label: Bigger loss, mostly stock pay
reasons.text: Net loss was $162M versus $29M a year ago, driven by about $119M of stock-based pay.
